MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which pair of syllables has the same initial and final but a different meaning because of the tone? (1 mark)
   A. nǐ (you) and hǎo (good)
   B. mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)
   C. dà (big) and xiǎo (small)
   D. bā (eight) and mā (mother)

2. How does the voice move in the second tone? (1 mark)
   A. It rises
   B. It dips and rises
   C. It falls sharply
   D. It stays flat

3. Which sentence means "That is my older brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是谁?
   B. 我爱你。
   C. 那是我哥哥。
   D. 这是我妈妈。

4. What does 那是我哥哥 nà shì wǒ gēge mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my younger brother
   B. This is my sister
   C. That is my older brother
   D. That is my mother

5. What is the Chinese question for "Where is the television?" (1 mark)
   A. 这是电视吗?
   B. 电视是谁?
   C. 电视在哪儿?
   D. 电视有什么?

6. What does 他们 (tāmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. They
   C. We
   D. Cup

7. What does 咖啡 (kāfēi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Coffee
   B. Dinner
   C. To eat
   D. Lunch

8. Which verb goes with 米饭? (1 mark)
   A. 看
   B. 吃
   C. 喝
   D. 来

9. Fill the blank: 我用嘴巴____。 (I use my mouth to speak.) (1 mark)
   A. 听
   B. 看
   C. 摸
   D. 说

10. Which sentence means "Today there are clouds."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 今天有云。
   D. 今天下雨。

11. What does 老师 (lǎoshī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Teacher
   B. You
   C. And you? (a question word)
   D. To be called

12. Which Chinese word means "classmates"? (1 mark)
   A. 你 nǐ
   B. 叫 jiào
   C. 我 wǒ
   D. 同学们 tóngxuémen

13. In the syllable mā, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. ā only with a dot
   B. a
   C. m
   D. ma

14. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子上____? (Is the television on the table?) (1 mark)
   A. 吗
   B. 了
   C. 的
   D. 呢

15. What is intonation? (1 mark)
   A. The spelling of a word
   B. How the voice rises and falls
   C. The size of a character
   D. The number of strokes

16. Fill the blank: 星期一,星期二,星期____。 (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday) (1 mark)
   A. 五
   B. 四
   C. 三
   D. 天

17. What does 教堂 (jiàotáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Church
   D. Yesterday

18. In reading aloud, what is stress? (1 mark)
   A. Reading in a whisper
   B. Stopping after every word
   C. Saying an important word a little stronger
   D. Reading without tones

19. Which sentence means "When is your birthday?"? (1 mark)
   A. 朋友送我礼物。
   B. 我们唱歌。
   C. 你生日是几月几号?
   D. 我们切蛋糕。

20. Which Chinese word means "to play"? (1 mark)
   A. 蛋糕 dàngāo
   B. 切 qiē
   C. 他们 tāmen
   D. 玩 wán

21. What clue tells you that 咖啡 is a drink in 我喝咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. The word 我
   B. The verb 吃
   C. The full stop
   D. The verb 喝

22. What does 头 (tóu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ear
   B. Eye
   C. Head
   D. Tooth

23. What is the main idea of a text? (1 mark)
   A. The first letter
   B. The last word
   C. What the whole text is about
   D. The title font

24. What does 花园 (huāyuán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sofa
   B. Garden
   C. Living room
   D. Beside

25. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello! (polite)
   B. Hello!
   C. My name is Xiaoming.
   D. Good morning!

26. Which tone mark is written in bàba? (1 mark)
   A. No marks
   B. One mark, on the first a
   C. A mark on the last a
   D. Two marks

27. What does 休息 (xiūxi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday
   B. Today
   C. To rest
   D. Church

28. What does 香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Biscuits
   B. Water
   C. Drinks
   D. Banana

29. On which vowel is the tone mark in zuǐba? (1 mark)
   A. a
   B. No vowel
   C. u
   D. i

30. Which sentence means "The window is above the sofa."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在门旁边。
   B. 冰箱在厨房。
   C. 窗户在沙发上面。
   D. 电视在哪儿?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谢谢, 哭 and 星期三. (3 marks)

32. Blend the syllables zhuō and zi and give the meaning. (2 marks)

33. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期二 and 晚饭. (2 marks)

34. Explain why a healthy plate should have food from several groups and name two groups with their Chinese names. (4 marks)

35. Write a short dialogue of four lines in Chinese with pinyin: two friends greet each other and one says it is their birthday. (4 marks)

36. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 儿子 and 浴室. (2 marks)

37. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "For breakfast I eat bǐng." (2 marks)

38. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is on the table." (3 marks)

39. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a bed in the bedroom." (2 marks)

40. Explain one way rain helps the environment and one way too much rain harms it. (4 marks)

41. Write these position words in Chinese with pinyin: beside, above and below. (3 marks)

42. Write a short paragraph in Chinese with pinyin that says there are four people in your family and names three of them. (5 marks)

43. Read and translate: 星期一到星期五,去学校。 (3 marks)

44. Answer the riddle in Chinese with pinyin: "I help you hear. I am on the sides of your head." (2 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

46. Explain when we use 吃 and when we use 喝. (2 marks)

47. Write the difference between a statement and a question when reading aloud, with an example. (3 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 月 and 太阳. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)
   Only the tone separates mā and mǎ.

2. A — It rises
   The second tone rises, like asking "What?"

3. C — 那是我哥哥。
   那是我哥哥。 (nà shì wǒ gēge.) means "That is my older brother.".

4. C — That is my older brother
   那 is that and 哥哥 is older brother.

5. C — 电视在哪儿?
   哪儿 is where and takes the place of the answer.

6. B — They
   他们 (tāmen) means they.

7. A — Coffee
   咖啡 (kāfēi) means coffee.

8. B — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

9. D — 说
   说 is to speak.

10. C — 今天有云。
   今天有云。 (jīntiān yǒu yún.) means "Today there are clouds.".

11. A — Teacher
   老师 (lǎoshī) means teacher.

12. D — 同学们 tóngxuémen
   同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

13. B — a
   m is the initial and a is the final, with the first tone.

14. A — 吗
   吗 turns the statement into a yes-or-no question.

15. B — How the voice rises and falls
   Intonation is the rise and fall of the voice.

16. C — 三
   The next day after Tuesday is Wednesday, 星期三.

17. C — Church
   教堂 (jiàotáng) means church.

18. C — Saying an important word a little stronger
   Stress makes key words stand out but does not change the tone.

19. C — 你生日是几月几号?
   你生日是几月几号? (nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?) means "When is your birthday?".

20. D — 玩 wán
   玩 (wán) means to play.

21. D — The verb 喝
   喝 means to drink.

22. C — Head
   头 (tóu) means head.

23. C — What the whole text is about
   Details support the main idea.

24. B — Garden
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

25. C — My name is Xiaoming.
   wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. is 我叫小明。, which means "My name is Xiaoming.".

26. B — One mark, on the first a
   The second syllable is light, so it has no mark.

27. C — To rest
   休息 (xiūxi) means to rest.

28. D — Banana
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

29. D — i
   In ui the second vowel takes the mark.

30. C — 窗户在沙发上面。
   窗户在沙发上面。 (chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.) means "The window is above the sofa.".

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢: xièxie, thank you. 哭: kū, to cry. 星期三: xīngqīsān, Wednesday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: zhuōzi, table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期二: xīngqī'èr, Tuesday. 晚饭: wǎnfàn, dinner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Each group does a different job. Vegetables and fruit (蔬菜, 水果) give vitamins, rice (米饭) gives energy, and meat (肉) helps the body grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 1 mark for each group named, 1 mark for the job.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好! nǐ hǎo! A: 今天是我的生日。 jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. B: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line, with pinyin.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 儿子: érzi, son. 浴室: yùshì, bathroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 卧室里有床。 wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Rain gives water to crops, rivers and animals. Too much rain can cause floods that damage crops and homes.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the benefit and 2 marks for the harm.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 旁边 pángbiān, 上面 shàngmiàn, 下面 xiàmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有四口人。这是我爸爸,这是我妈妈,这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma, zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the family size sentence, 2 marks for three correct sentences, 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for punctuation.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, qù xuéxiào. From Monday to Friday, go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin and 2 marks for the meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 耳朵 ěrduo (ears).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the pinyin.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: We use 吃 with foods to say eat, and we use 喝 with drinks to say drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: A statement ends a little lower, like 电视在客厅。 A question ends a little higher, like 电视在哪儿? Every syllable keeps its tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each and 1 mark for keeping the tones.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 月: yuè, month. 太阳: tàiyáng, sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
